content.summary: Shutterstock (SSTK) reported earnings that are forecast to climb 12.3% per year, with revenue expected to rise at a rate of 2.9% annually. The company’s net profit margin has improved to 6.4%, up from 5.3% a year earlier, and earnings growth in the past year reached 36.4%. However, results for the most recent 12 months were affected by a one-off $32.6 million loss, highlighting the importance of digging deeper than surface-level growth.
